pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit irregular polygonal geometries with soft, smooth-gradient edges and low-contrast transitions. Spatial area is variable, with larger, elongated patches on the neck transitioning to smaller, more fragmented patches on the visible portion of the forelimb.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored negative space forms a continuous network of intersecting pathways. Junction nodes consist primarily of three-way intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank and neck regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane silhouette along the upper neck displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D profile against the background exposure.
